newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse mixed in idle trading.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse mixed in idle trading.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse, becalmed by a lack of foreign interest, closed mixed on Tuesday.
"Foreign buyers stayed on the sidelines again in expectation of better prices," one trader said. Investors, he said, had shown only limited interest at the height of the summer holiday period.
Operators said demand might recover for high-caps in coming days, but the overall downward trend was likely to continue.
On Tuesday, prices of 24 stocks rose and another 24 fell. Two companies were suspended, while one had no trade.
Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, inched down by 0.33, 0.32 and 0.25 percent respectively from previous day.
On the first tier, four listings gained in average price, two slipped and two were flat.
The State Ownership Fund (FPS) announcement of a sell-off of 51 percent of Policolor dye maker had little effect on its price, one trader said.

"I expected Policolor to move up after the FPS sold its majority stake, but this was not so," one said. Investors were reluctant to pay more than 6,550 lei for a share, where it settled, 50 lei firmer.
On the second-tier, prices were volatile in thin supply. Traders said lack of liquidity had eroded investors' appetite for small-cap listings.
Total turnover was 8.6 billion lei, slightly up from 7.9 billion on Monday.
